title: Refresh stale audit-check/ARB-key/test-file counts in docs/development-guide.md

evidence.quote: app_en.arb, app_he.arb (~468 keys, keep in parity — see make arb-parity)
Firebase confined — firebase_auth/cloud_firestore/firebase_storage only in core/sync/ + features/auth/
echo "22/22 — Every lib/core/labels/ file touching displayNameEn/He must be variant-aware..."

why: learning_tracker/Makefile's audit target runs 22 checks (not 13); lib/l10n/app_en.arb has 1421 translatable keys (not ~468 — a 3x undercount); learning_tracker/test/ has 770 *_test.dart files (not 359 — more than double). The Firebase-confinement summary also omits core/auth/, which legitimately imports firebase_auth (auth_gateway_user.dart, firebase_auth_gateway_impl.dart, etc.) alongside core/sync/ and features/auth/. This file is explicitly positioned (via CONTRIBUTING.md) as 'the authoritative reference for setup, testing, and conventions' — a contributor sizing the test suite or the audit gate off these numbers gets roughly 2-3x wrong figures.
recommendation: Re-derive all four figures from the live repo (Makefile check count, arb key count via the arb-parity tool, test file count, and the core/auth/ Firebase-confinement location) and update development-guide.md.
acceptance_criteria: development-guide.md's stated audit check count matches the number of numbered checks in learning_tracker/Makefile's audit target
development-guide.md's ARB key count matches app_en.arb's non-metadata key count
development-guide.md's test file count matches `find learning_tracker/test -name '*_test.dart' | wc -l`

corrections: Test-file count: `find learning_tracker/test -name '*_test.dart' | wc -l` gives 768, not 770 as the finding states (verified 3 ways). Doc's stale '359' is still ~2.1x undercount regardless; core claim unaffected.
